paper_title: DeltaEdit Enhancing Sequential Editing in Large Language Models by   Controlling Superimposed Noise
caption: The variation curve of k^⊤β for AlphaEdit and MEMIT as the number of edits increases, with GPT2-XL serving as the edited model. As the results of Llama3-8B are not suitable for display in a line chart, they are presented in Appendix <ref>.

model_annotations.English:
The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of edits and the value of k<sup>⊤</sup>β for different models. The x-axis is labeled “Number of edits”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 3000, and has tick marks every 500 units. The y-axis is labeled “k<sup>⊤</sup>β”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0.002 to 0.012, and has tick marks every 0.002 units. 

A red line with circular markers represents AlphaEdit k<sup>⊤</sup>β, starting at approximately 0.0038 at 0 edits and decreasing to approximately 0.0019 at 1000 edits before remaining relatively stable at around 0.0018 up to 3000 edits. A blue line with circular markers represents MEMIT k<sup>⊤</sup>β, beginning at approximately 0.0034 at 0 edits and increasing steadily to around 0.0116 at 3000 edits.
model_annotations.German:
The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of edits and the value of kᵀβ for AlphaEdit and MEMIT, using GPT2-XL as the edited model. The x-axis is labeled as the number of edits and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 3000, with tick labels at intervals of 500. The y-axis is labeled as kᵀβ and has a linear scale ranging from 0.000 to 0.012, with tick labels at intervals of 0.002. 

The AlphaEdit data is represented by a red line with circular markers. Starting at a value of approximately 0.004 at 0 edits, the line declines to 0.002 at 500 edits, then continues to decrease slightly to approximately 0.0015 at 3000 edits.

The MEMIT data is represented by a blue line with circular markers. Starting at approximately 0.005 at 0 edits, the line increases to 0.0075 at 1000 edits, then continues to increase to 0.011 at 2000 edits, and reaches a value of 0.0125 at 3000 edits.
